title: Missing NEL response header
description: The response omits NEL, so no Network Error Logging policy is stored for this origin. NEL is an observability control: it reports failed and misconfigured requests that never reach the server. Its absence does not weaken a browser protection, but it leaves certificate, DNS and connection failures invisible to the operator.
remediation: If the origin has an error collector, send NEL with a report-to group and a max_age, and define that group in Report-To. If there is no collector, record the decision; sending NEL alone has no effect.
limitation: Header-name check on one response. It cannot tell whether an error collector exists, and it does not validate the report group the header would name.
